annotations.title: Search internship and student programs in Vietnam

description: Find internship, fresher, graduate, management-trainee and scholarship programs for students and new graduates in Vietnam, in tech and other fields: whether applications are open, the deadline and the career field. Open programs come first, soonest deadline first. Use when a student asks about internships or programs; for individual job postings use search_jobs. Then get_program for one program's details.

field.description: Career field, one of: tech, finance, audit-consulting, business, operations, engineering, hr, general.

limit.description: Maximum programs to return (default 10): up to 10 without sign-in, 50 when signed in.

page.description: Page of `limit` results, starting at 1; up to page 3 without sign-in.

query.description: Part of the program name, company or track, accents optional, e.g. "kiem toan" or "backend".

status.description: open = accepting applications now, upcoming = opens soon, closed = reopens on a later cycle, unknown = no dates yet.

type.description: Kind of program, one of: internship, fresher, graduate, management_trainee, ambassador, scholarship.

name: search_programs

apply_url.description: The program's official page, where applications are submitted.

deadline.description: Application deadline of the current or last cycle, YYYY-MM-DD.

opens_at.description: Date the current or last cycle opens, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: techjobs.vn page with the details; share this link.

title: Search internship and student programs in Vietnam
